name: NeRF-based View Morphing
definition: A method that uses geometrical constraints of view morphing to synthesize additional training input views M = {M(k,k′ ),α } from a view pair k and k′ with parameter α, solving the challenge of sparse training data in NeRF by generating intermediate views via pixel correspondence and interpolation.
summary: NeRF-based View Morphing synthesizes photometrically consistent intermediate views from sparse camera pairs using geometric constraints and disparity warping to improve NeRF reconstruction quality.
